original_test_intent: Verify every required CX8 management sensor for each installed board, cable and port, correlating name, description, reading and status across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web with the authoritative CX8 specification.
original_method: Freeze the CX8 board/PCIe/port/cable/link population, map physical identities to stable sensor records, retain complete IB/OOB inventories at aligned timestamps, capture all Web rows, normalize sensor fields and correlate passive device, link and thermal health without changing ports or thresholds.
manual_activity: The network/platform owner supplies the CX8 physical-to-sensor map and resolves whether criteria 3–16 are missing; an operator verifies complete BMC-Web evidence and the owner issues the verdict.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/CX8 board serial, PCIe BDF/slot, firmware, cable and port/link identities
Installed/applicable population and authoritative CX8 sensor specification
Sensor types, units, expected ranges/states, thresholds and freshness
Expected PCIe and port link speed/width/FEC plus permitted counters/errors for passive context
Secure collection and complete Web capture method
Criteria 3–16 disposition, timing/cache/rounding rules and escalation owner
safety_requirements: Keep the row passive; do not reset ports, flap links, remove cables/boards or alter sensors
Protect credentials and retain complete outputs before CX8 filtering
Bind every record to exact board/port/cable identity and do not accept the test title as an SDR name
Do not truncate or clear SEL, host, driver or link evidence
Stop on ambiguous identity, missing/duplicate/stale data, degraded PCIe/link state, new errors or thermal alarm
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source identity and collect complete read-only IB/OOB inventories
Apply the owner-approved CX8 physical-to-sensor map and normalize fields
Correlate passive PCIe, port/link, driver and thermal health and prepare Web parity evidence
Perform no hardware/link action, threshold write, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve CX8 board/cable/port population, sensor mapping and expected semantics
Resolve the criteria-number gap and any omitted CX8 checks
Review all mapped members and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only ipmitool is applicable, but `sensor get 'Sensor Check - CX8'` invents a record and its OOB-only truncated fallback omits IB, Web and topology completeness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists through secure access, select every owner-mapped CX8 record, capture all Web rows and correlate passive board/port/link state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, CX8 view, BMC Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute estimates remain; no automatic log clear.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Join CX8 board serial/PCIe identity and port/cable map to stable sensor records, then compare complete IB/OOB/Web fields with passive negotiation and thermal context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact physical attribution and link context without introducing active network operations.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One generic value cannot establish all boards and ports, detect partial port recovery or distinguish board, cable, port and thermal sensors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Naming and exposed telemetry depend on firmware and port population; mapping and applicability must be versioned.

project_override_considerations: Aggregate CX8 records are acceptable only with explicit coverage mapping. Absent ports/cables need specified N/A behavior. This sensor row does not authorize link disturbance.
expected_evidence: CX8 board/PCIe/cable/port population, firmware and versioned sensor map/spec
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps/exits
Complete Web evidence bound to physical CX8 members
Passive PCIe/link/FEC/counter/thermal context, criteria 3–16 decision, no-write/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master criteria jump from 2 to 17, while DeepSeek invents a title-based sensor and omits complete IB/Web/topology coverage. Stated CX8 scope is preserved and undefined criteria are escalated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive CX8 sensor objective is clear; topology/specification/mapping and criteria clarification are supplyable project inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2015 Wistron-BMC-01035-V002: confirm whether Criteria numbering 1, 2, 17 is only a numbering typo or whether CX8 Criteria 3–16 are missing; if missing, provide exact board/cable/port sensor coverage, expected values/states and IB/OOB/Web acceptance mapping.

review_improvement: Turns a fabricated one-sensor query into per-board/port reconciliation and exposes the fourteen-number criteria gap while preserving passive link and thermal evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: CX8 telemetry can be board-wide, per-port, cable-related or thermal, and multiple adapters may share similar labels. Only a map anchored in board serial, PCIe location and port identity prevents evidence from the wrong device from passing. Passive negotiation and counters reveal partial health that a sensor value alone misses. The source gives no authority to invent criteria 3–16.
